units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 11a:6">Ab. Zar. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ מחתך אוכל</he> radishes cut (digest) the food.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 4:6">Makhsh. IV, 6</cite> <he>צ׳ שבמערה</he> radishes that grow in the water of a cavern; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צְנוֹנוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 2:3">Tosef. ib. II, 3</cite> <he>מה יעשו … אלא שמן צ׳ בלבד</he> what shall the Alexandrians do who have only radish oil (for their lamps)? <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:9">Kil. I, 9</cite>; Y. ib. 27ᵇ; a. e.
